caseNameFull: Mary R. Trimble, in Error v. Ida V. Klugh
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of South Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. William A. Gunter for plaintiffs in error., Mr. F. Barron Grier for defendants in error.

opinions.text: Dismissed for want of jurisdiction, on authority of Empire State-Idaho Mining and Development Company v. Hanley, 205 U. S. 225.
